answer: Propose 100 expiring vote credits/day total for oasis pumps, issued only to fixed root keys; signup earns none. Each voting key burns 1 credit; transfers debit senders, and remaining credits set vote weight. Ledger validators freeze balances, verify burns and signatures, and reject invalid or replayed votes. Shared hosts or parallel keys cannot reuse credits. Cost recurs as lost voting power, not cash or locked stake. Root owners may dominate. Even if compute costs hit their nadir, an alias spiral shrinks weight: split 100 credits across ten keys for 90 votes, versus 99 with one key.
